data.one_liner: A draggable scrollbar for quickly navigating vertical lists with optional labels.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom scrollbar widget that users can drag to quickly scroll through vertical lists. It supports built-in scroll thumb styles like semicircle, arrows, and rounded rectangles, and can display labels next to the thumb showing current item information.
use_when: You need fast navigation through long vertical lists or grids.
You want to show contextual item labels next to the scroll thumb during dragging.
avoid_when: You only need the standard non-draggable platform scrollbar behavior.
strengths: Includes multiple built-in scroll thumb styles (semicircle, arrows, rounded rectangle).
Supports custom scroll thumb builders and label text generation.
weaknesses: Limited to vertical scrolling lists and grids.
Few recent updates documented beyond null safety.
